meta.name: behavioral-segmentation
meta.description: Analyze behavioral segmentation systems for RFM scoring, cohort tracking, churn propensity, engagement scoring, persona clustering, and journey mapping using behavioral economics frameworks. USE THIS SKILL WHEN: user mentions customer segmentation, RFM analysis, cohort analysis, churn prediction, engagement scoring, customer personas, journey mapping, retention analysis, customer lifetime value, or behavioral analytics. Trigger phrases: "segment my customers", "analyze churn", "RFM scoring", "cohort retention", "engagement model", "customer personas", "journey mapping", "why are customers leaving", "identify at-risk users", "behavioral segments".
